question.text: A distributor of Cat III AIFs can be empanelled with:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 82 directly states that a distributor can be empanelled with more than one Cat III AIF, so multiple empanelments are permissible. The Trap: No rule restricts a distributor to a single AIF, prohibits empanelment, or limits it to foreign AIFs. Note: Where applicable, disclose material conflicts of interest arising from such empanelments (pp. 346-347).
